rule.purposes: Taken word for word from the law's purpose clause or, failing that, its preamble, split at each "and" or semicolon that introduces a separate object. Applied as: split where "and" introduces a new verb clause ("and to enable", "and affirm") or a semicolon-separated item; nouns sharing one verb are not split. Where there is no purpose clause or preamble, one purpose is written by hand and marked source="hand-written".
rule.provisions: Every section that creates an offence, duty, power or right, listed once per law. Definitions, application and interpretation rules, deeming and evidence rules, immunities, defences, repealed or omitted sections and coming-into-force provisions are excluded, each with a stated reason in "excluded".
rule.text: The whole Act, or the whole of each Part the entry names; never a hand-trimmed excerpt. Where the entry names sections rather than a Part, the text is the Part that contains them and the provisions are limited to the entry.

scorer_contract_proposed: The scorer would read purposes[].id/text and provisions[].id/section/label as fixed inputs, give the model the statute text at text.file, and ask it only for serves_matrix[provision][purpose] (true/false with a quoted reason). F and X are then computed in code from that matrix. Unknown, duplicate or missing ids are rejected, not zero-filled.

fields.provisions[].creates: one or more of offence, duty, power, right; assigned from the operative verb (shall/must, may, offence wording, right/entitled) and to be read as orientation
fields.provisions[].label_source: heading/headnote/marginal note (verbatim) or opening words (verbatim, truncated with …)
